method: Each check below was independently re-read from the official NFL source URL listed, using page retrieval in this session. A value is VERIFIED only when it matches the official source. A value is BLANK when no official source publishes it and the site intentionally leaves it unpublished (never inferred). A value is FLAGGED when a conflict or gap was found. No value is estimated or filled in.
policy: The NFL's official betting data is distributed to operators through an exclusive distributor (Genius Sports); NFL.com does not publish historical market open/close prices, player-prop prices, official depth-chart ranks, or snap counts. Where those values are absent they are recorded as BLANK with the reason, not as findings.
